messages:
Mia: paging — alert from incident-bot at 03:12 UTC: model-inference-prod 99th latency > 1200ms. pinging oncall.
incident-bot: alert triggered for service=model-inference-prod severity=high; routed to #incidents and oncall (Mia).
Mia: I'm on it — checking queue depth + GPU metrics. ETA 5m.
Jamal: Jamal (SRE) joining, will check pods, autoscaler, and recent deploys.
Mia: logs (tail): lots of streaming token writes stalled, backlog ~ 1.2k requests queued. GPU util 95% on two hosts.
Olivia: Olivia here — no deploys in last 2 hours from infra. Could be sudden request shape change. Any partner spikes?
Mia: early signal points at partner-x long-running batches. I see many long prefix tokens.
Jamal: scaling isn't picking up fast enough — HPA saw sudden churn, possible stuck goroutines in inference proxy. Trying a pod restart on node-3.
Mia: rolling restart on node-3 now.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: restart job queued for node-3 (initiated by Jamal). logs attached.
Mia: restarting helped a bit — queue dropped to ~600. Latency 99th fell to ~800ms but still elevated.
Priya: Priya (prodops): can we throttle partner-x connections temporarily? They have a high request rate.
Olivia: can we put partner-x route on degraded mode (lower concurrency) or route to a smaller model as fallback?
Mia: I'm toggling partner-x rate limit to 0.2x now.
Jamal: applied temporary rate limit, cleared a few stuck streams (`curl -X POST /v1/admin/streams/clear`).
Mia: after rate limit and remainder restarts, latency back to baseline ~120ms at 03:46 UTC. Queue emptied.
Mia: marking incident mitigated (03:46). Notifying impacted teams + customers.
incident-bot: incident mitigated; closing on-call paging. create a follow-up thread for RCA.
Priya: thanks — can we get a quick customer impact summary for post-incident update?
Mia: quick numbers: ~3200 requests affected (elevated latency), ~120 requests error 5xx, peak impact window ~03:12–03:46 (34 minutes). 6 customers reported user-facing errors; one partner integration (partner-x) had most of the traffic.
Raj: Raj (product): customer-facing note draft: apology + root cause summary + mitigation + ETA for RCA. I'll draft after we have RCA timeline.
Mia: handoff: I'm the responder until 05:00 UTC then handing to daytime oncall Jamal for writeup follow-through.
Jamal: acknowledged handoff at 04:02 UTC. I'll drive the RCA doc and coordinate reviewers.
Mia: adding immediate action item: temporary rate limit removal only after partner-x confirms fix. Owner: Priya. Due: 2026-02-10 12:00 UTC.
Priya: acknowledged. I'll reach out to partner-x and confirm expected traffic pattern.
Olivia: engineering follow-ups: 1) add faster drain/restart playbook for inference nodes (owner: Olivia), 2) investigate HPA not scaling quickly for bursty streaming (owner: Jamal), 3) add feature to route long prefixes to larger KV cache (owner: eng-runtime team).
Jamal: will open infra tickets for HPA tuning and pod lifecycle. Estimated ETA for HPA config PR: 3 days.
Olivia: I'll start a short doc for improved autoscaler heuristics.
Mia: scheduling: let's get an RCA draft in 48 hours. Draft owner Jamal. Reviewers: Olivia, Priya, Raj. Legal consult Sam for customer wording if there are contract implications.
Sam: Sam (legal) — happy to review customer wording. Please ping me when draft is ready.
Jamal: plan for RCA timeline: 1) initial draft by 2026-02-12 04:00 UTC, 2) internal peer review 24h, 3) sign-off by eng lead + prod + legal by 2026-02-15.
Priya: can we have a short follow-up meeting? 2026-02-12 09:00 UTC works for me.
Olivia: available. Jamal, please schedule a 30-min RCA review sync and share draft in #incidents before meeting.
Jamal: will schedule and post link. Action items summary (short):
- A1: Contact partner-x + confirm traffic fix — Priya — due 2026-02-10 12:00 UTC
- A2: Draft RCA timeline + initial writeup — Jamal — due 2026-02-12 04:00 UTC
- A3: HPA tuning PR & infra tickets — Jamal — due 2026-02-15
- A4: Restart/drain playbook + runbook updates — Olivia — due 2026-02-14
- A5: Customer-facing comms draft — Raj + Sam review — due 2026-02-13
- A6: Add routing fallback / KV cache improvement proposal — eng-runtime — owner Olivia — due 2026-02-20

Mia: logged the actions in the incident tracker (link: https://internal.redwood/incident/1865004321).
incident-bot: action items added to tracker (IDs: INC-1865004321-A1..A6).
Raj: I'll coordinate the customer note with Sam once Jamal posts RCA highlights.
Jamal: initial notes I'll include in RCA draft: timeline, mitigations, contributing factors (partner traffic spike + streaming request shapes + slow autoscaler reaction + stuck streams), tests to prevent recurrence, and sign-off checklist.
Olivia: please include metrics we should monitor post-change (99th latency by route, queue depth, per-partner request rate).
Jamal: noted. Final sign-off criteria: engineering review completed, mitigation plan accepted, customer comms reviewed by legal/product.
Mia: great work everyone. If you catch anything else odd from 03:00–05:00 logs, paste here.
Priya: I'll post partner-x confirmation once I hear back.
Sam: I'll be on standby for customer wording review.
Jamal: scheduling note — meeting invite sent for 2026-02-12 09:00 UTC, calendar link pasted in #incidents. Draft will be in the incident tracker by 04:00 UTC that day.
Mia: handing off oncall to Jamal at 05:00 UTC. Closing this paging thread but keeping RCA thread open. :white_check_mark:
